policy: Current suggested cargo; 4/6/8 purchased oxen; April/May 1 departures; three capitals; default seed-matched unpaid companions; no-hunt/dry/salt; existing adaptive cautious public-action policy with scripted 65% aim. Salt can fall back to drying. No slaughter, crime, peaceful-camp visits or replacement hires. Two ration units when well, three if any active traveler is ill or below 80 health. Every 80 actions and final saves round-tripped. No data overrides or tuning. Small diagnostic, not a representative historical or held-out cohort. Corrected effect-based toll fundraising; waiting is an actual day. Action categories include all days spent by the action, including resulting effects. Abort after33 consecutive actions without time/distance progress. Full policy in tests/full_trail_balance.gd.
